Notices for packages bundled inside dragula.min.js

dragula.min.js is the browserify build of dragula 3.7.3 from the npm package. The
packages below are compiled into it next to dragula (whose licence is in LICENSE).
Licence texts are copied from the npm tarballs of the versions named. The bundle also
contains browserify's Node shims (process, timers); timers-browserify is given at the
nearest installable version, 2.0.12, since the bundle does not record its version.
